mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TOUR_SYNC_HISTORY ( SYNC_HISTORY_ID, ADMIN_ID, PROVIDER_CODE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, TOTAL_COUNT, INSERT_COUNT, UPDATE_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, FAIL_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, PROCESS_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_TOUR_SYNC_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, (SELECT ADMIN_ID FROM ADMIN WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{managerLoginId}), 'TOUR_API', #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{successCount}, 0, 0, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{processStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT syncHistoryId, startedAt, finishedAt, successCount, failCount, processStatus, manager FROM ( SELECT history.SYNC_HISTORY_ID AS syncHistoryId, history.STARTED_AT AS startedAt, history.FINISHED_AT AS finishedAt, history.SUCCESS_COUNT AS successCount, history.FAIL_COUNT AS failCount, history.PROCESS_STATUS AS processStatus, admin.LOGIN_ID AS manager FROM TOUR_SYNC_HISTORY history JOIN ADMIN admin ON admin.ADMIN_ID = history.ADMIN_ID ORDER BY history.STARTED_AT DESC, history.SYNC_HISTORY_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
